quests.title: Sightline at the Bankstown pho strip
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Insurance says nobody could have seen the ute hit the fence at the Bankstown pho strip on Friday. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Stand where I stood in Bankstown, photograph the view, tell me if I'm lying. Whatever you find, bring it to me first.

steps.label: stand where it happened at the Bankstown pho strip
photograph the corner
describe the sightline

quests.title: Meat Tray at Restwell Street
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. The Restwell Street raffle is thirty-five short of a meat tray and the draw is at bin night. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. Find it in Bankstown and put it in the tin. Take your time. Do not take a week.

steps.label: raise thirty-five for the meat tray
and drop it at Restwell Street

quests.title: The Restwell Street Float
quests.blurb: Before you say anything: yes, I know. The till at Restwell Street opens the last Sunday of the month with an empty float because somebody took it to the pub. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Sixty before the first Bankstown customer, and I'll never say who. That's the whole job. No catch.

steps.label: clear sixty for the Restwell Street float
hand it over at the counter

quests.title: Cover at Jacobs Street
quests.blurb: Not being dramatic about this. I've got nobody for the Jacobs Street shift at ten past ten and a room full of Bankstown people who've paid. I have rung the number on the letter four times. Fifty of trade and one difficult person at the door. Whatever it costs you, tell me and I will cover it.

steps.label: cover the fifty for the shift
and handle whoever's at the door

quests.title: Counting Jacobs Street
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. Council says the Jacobs Street car park is never full and I say it's full by bin night. It started small, the way these things do. Count both Bankstown car parks, photograph whichever one makes me right. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: count the cars at Jacobs Street
then the other car park
photograph the fuller one

quests.title: The the Bankstown Arts Centre Lift
quests.blurb: I would do it myself if I could leave the counter. The lift at Bankstown station has been out since the Easter Show and I'm told Lakemba is worse. It has been going on longer than I have admitted to anyone. Check both Melbourne Cup day and tell me which takes a pram. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: check the lift at Bankstown station
then ride to Lakemba and check theirs
report which one works

quests.title: Something From Bankstown Central
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The stall at Bankstown Central has run out and the customers keep coming. It is the not knowing that has got me, honestly. Find something round Bankstown that'll do before the ten past ten rush. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

steps.label: pick something up near Bankstown Central
bring it to the stall

quests.title: Lads Off the Bankstown Sports Club
quests.blurb: You are the first person to stop all morning. Three of them in TNs on the the Bankstown Sports Club steps, flogging vapes to schoolkids at closing. I did try the official route, for what that was worth. Bankstown used to move them on itself and now it rings me. I'll see you right for it.

steps.label: move the lads on from the Bankstown Sports Club

quests.title: The Paul Keating Park Sparky
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. The sparky off the Paul Keating Park job has owed me since the bathroom and drinks in Bankstown from the last train. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Forty will do and I'll write off the rest. If anyone asks, you were never here.

steps.label: find the sparky who owes for Paul Keating Park
and get forty of it

quests.title: RBT on Chapel Road
quests.blurb: I'll be straight with you. There's a breath test set up on Chapel Road since ten past ten. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. My brother-in-law needs the ute at the far end of Bankstown without a conversation. Come and find me after, either way.

steps.label: get past the breath test on Chapel Road
then meet the ute at the far end

quests.title: Parcel for Lakemba
quests.blurb: Do not laugh. A parcel from the Bankstown Bulldogs has to be at Lakemba by midnight and Australia Post quoted me Saturday. I have got a photo on my phone but it is useless. Take the train and hand it to the people outside the station. Be polite about it. It costs nothing.

steps.label: carry it on the train to Lakemba
hand it over outside the station, where the crowd is

quests.title: Race Four, Old Town Plaza
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. There's a horse in race four at the last train that a bloke at Old Town Plaza swears by. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Turn it into fifty-five somewhere in Bankstown and tell me if it came in. I would rather know than wonder.

steps.label: turn the tip into fifty-five
tell me if it came in

quests.title: Closing Time at the Bankstown Bulldogs
quests.blurb: The council knows and the council does not care. Two blokes have slept in my doorway on the Bankstown Bulldogs since the pub shut. You will see what I mean the second you get there. The Bankstown delivery's at nine sharp, so get them up and show me the step empty. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: walk the two drunks off the Bankstown Bulldogs
and show me the doorway clear

quests.title: One Stop From the Bankstown Bulldogs
quests.blurb: Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I need to know the train from Bankstown stops at Lakemba and doesn't sail through like it did on Saturday. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Ride it at midnight and photograph the sign. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: take the train to Lakemba
and photograph the platform sign

quests.title: The the Bankstown pho strip Fence
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. My neighbour at the Bankstown pho strip says the tree is on my side and the fence says otherwise. I am aware how that sounds. Look at it Australia Day with Bankstown eyes and tell me the truth. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: go and look at the fence at the Bankstown pho strip
photograph the tree over it
tell me whose side it's on

quests.title: The Length of Restwell Street
quests.blurb: It is not a police matter and I have checked. I haven't walked Restwell Street end to end since the light rail came to Bankstown. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. Do it the last Sunday of the month for me and photograph what's at the far end now. Come back and tell me straight.

steps.label: walk the length of Restwell Street
to the far end
photograph what's there now

quests.title: Rent Money, Bankstown Central
quests.blurb: Nobody else has offered, so. I'm forty-five short on the Bankstown Central rent and the agent doesn't take stories. This is the third time I have had this conversation. Make it somewhere in Bankstown by half six; I'm not fussy how. There is no rush, but there is a Friday.

steps.label: earn forty-five somewhere in Bankstown

quests.title: Two From the Bankstown Arts Centre
quests.blurb: Two people have already said no. Two of whatever's going near the Bankstown Arts Centre, here, hot, before the footy at the change of shift. The paperwork says one thing and my eyes say another. It's Bankstown; I'm not asking for much. If it's nothing, it's nothing. Tell me anyway.
